title: Dog Night, 2003 · before (unprinted)
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
arc: The Unprinted Year / The Dog Night
logline: The night before four years, unprinted like everything since May: Wood at the laundromat's window from outside, the rack gone, the dog at his boot. He goes there first, then the alley. The strip doesn't say why he checks.

panels.composition: The laundromat's window from the sidewalk at night, the pale rectangle where the rack was. WOOD and BARNABY.
